6AS6.stand_in: EF86 (Koren-format fit); Koren's own 6AN8P pentode fit is kept in the code as a second reference
6AS6.why: No published Koren/other fit found. 6AS6 is a sharp-cutoff dual-control pentode (Tung-Sol data: Va=Vg2=120 V, Vg1=-2 V, Vg3=-3 V, Ia=3.6 mA, gm(g1)=1850 umho, gm(g3)=810 umho). Its suppressor-grid control is NOT modelled by any Koren pentode equation.

5963.why: No published fit found. RCA data: medium-mu twin triode, mu=21, rp~6600 ohm, gm=3200 umho at Va=67.5 V, Vg=0, Ia=8.5 mA; widely described as close to 12AU7 near typical bias.
